notes.title: Lust Academy 2: Enhanced Experience!
notes.notes:
[b]Lust Academy 2 major update![/b]

We're delighted to present a major update that will enhance your gaming experience at Lust Academy 2. For those who haven't decided yet, we have an extra incentive for you to join us. Read all the details about the special offer after the 'What's New' announcement!

[b]So, What's New?[/b]

[u]Sex Non-stop![/u]
Sandbox's main update, after which you could have sex with some characters on a daily basis!

[u]Fresh Adventures in the Sandbox[/u]
6 brand-new scenes that promise to take your Sandbox gameplay to a whole new level!

[u]More Renders[/u]
More than 400 dazzling, high-quality renders, complemented by a whopping 70 dynamic animations!

[u]Gallery Expansion[/u]
The Gallery feature gets a boost with the addition of 6 exciting new episodes. Explore, relive in the captivating world of Lust Academy.

[u]Massive Dialog Update![/u]
We've put in the effort to rewrite and proofread a lot of dialogues, ensuring a smoother and more engaging narrative.

[u]Bugfixes![/u]
Of course, we've also taken care of a few minor bugfixes to enhance your overall gaming experience.

[b]And now, a special offer for those who have read but have not yet experienced what's happening in our Lust Academy: [b]we're offering a limited-time discount of 20% on the game[/b]. Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Join us now and start your epic journey today! Hurry, this special offer is valid for only 7 days.[/b]

Get ready to dive back into the game and discover a whole new dimension of fun and adventure. We can't wait to hear your thoughts!

notes.title: Lust Element now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[b]Lust Element[/b], the highly anticipated adult visual novel game, is [b]finally available on Steam! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076813/6258de29438f7ca1bfc68074c5077871530daa9e.png[/img]

The game takes you on an [b]intergalactic adventure[/b] as a captain of a mining spaceship, where you'll encounter various alien species, each with their own unique personalities and storylines. From primitive to highly advanced, the universe of Lust Element is [b]full of surprises[/b], and you'll never know whether an alien girl will gift you a night of pleasure or a poisoned dart in your neck. The game features a lot of [b]different romanceable characters[/b], each with their own individual, optional, storylines. Rise to be one of the main players in the big intergalactic political game as you make your moves wisely. 

The full season of Lust Element is [b]now available on Steam[/b], so don't miss out on this epic cosmic journey!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2196490/Lust_Element__Season_1/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=news&utm_campaign=rlsla_20_07]Try it here![/url]

notes.title: Meet Lust Academy Season 2 trading cards!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076813/87e90330f133294dfe966a2d757a8232ab53b099.png[/img]

We're happy to announce that from now on, by playing Lust Academy, you can earn one of 14 unique trading cards with beautiful characters! Such as Haley, Samantha, Naomi, Lily, Adele, Victoria & Audrey, and others!

And if you're new to Steam trading cards, you'd be pleasantly surprised to know that by trading a set of these cards, you can earn a special badge for your Steam profile! You'll also get a unique profile pic and background. But the coolest part is that you can actually trade cards up to five times to increase your badge level and get additional rewards. How cool is that?

We hope you'll enjoy this news and the new possibilities!

[b]Thank you for your support and attention.[/b]

[i]Sincerely,
Bear in the Night team[/i]

notes.title: Crowdin now available for Lust Academy Season 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41675743/7c6c38011b0c873fbb5014613b549bb6f1c5698e.png[/img]

[b]Greetings everyone! [/b]

We want to thank everyone for your incredible support so far, we really appreciate it!

With that in mind, we are pleased to announce that we will be using a new system to allow the dedicated members from our community to assist with our games translations! 

Help us expand the [u]Lust Academy[/u] community around the world 😀

[b]Introducing Crowdin[/b]

Crowdin is a platform driven by community users that aims to provide support and help people translate games to their native language.

We’ve now have Lust Academy 2 on the Crowdin platform, and [b]you guys[/b] can help us to translate and create more language options for the game.

All you’ve got to do is join the [url=https://crowdin.com/project/lust-academy-2/invite?d=a575o4u4p607i593b3c3p4m4h4]Crowdin project[/url], select which language you want to help with the translation, and start translating the lines!

We also have [url=https://discord.gg/YRDZDpKYue]Discord[/url] channels dedicated to users that are assisting us with the game translation, so join in and help our game alongside our community.

Thanks for the support!
